title: TDP-43 multidomains and RNA modulate interactions and viscoelasticity in biomolecular condensates.
authors: Matsushita, Yui; Yasuda, Ikki; Watanabe, Fuga; Yamamoto, Eiji
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究TDP-43多结构域与RNA互作对相分离凝聚体粘弹性的调控，虽涉及蛋白-RNA互作和物理模拟，但对象为RNA结合蛋白与RNA而非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移但非核心聚焦。
abstract: RNA-binding proteins form biomolecular condensates with RNA through phase separation, playing crucial roles in various cellular processes. Although intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) are key drivers of phase separation, additional factors such as folded domains and RNA also influence condensate formation and physical properties. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying this regulation remain elusive. Here, using molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate how the multidomain structure of TDP-43, which consists of its IDR, RNA recognition motifs (RRMs), and N-terminal domain (NTD), interacts with RNA and affects the characteristics of phase separation. Our analysis reveals that interactions via the IDR are dominant in all domain constructs, particularly around residues R268-F276. RRM2 increases condensate packing, whereas NTD decreases it. Upon RNA binding, several intermolecular interactions of TDP-43 are replaced by TDP-43-polyA interactions, altering viscoelastic properties of the condensate. Specifically, RRMs enhance viscosity, whereas the NTD reduces it. The presence of polyA increases elasticity, making viscosity and elasticity comparable in magnitude. These findings suggest that the multidomain structure of TDP-43 and its RNA interactions orchestrate condensate organization, modulating their viscoelastic properties.
abstract_zh: RNA结合蛋白通过相分离（phase separation）与RNA形成生物分子凝聚体，在多种细胞过程中发挥关键作用。尽管 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) 是相分离的关键驱动因素，但折叠结构域和RNA等其他因素也影响凝聚体的形成及物理性质。然而，这种调控背后的分子机制仍不清楚。在此，我们利用分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，研究TDP-43的多结构域结构（由IDR、RNA识别基序（RRMs）和N端结构域（NTD）组成）如何与RNA相互作用并影响相分离的特性。我们的分析揭示，在所有结构域构建体中，通过IDR的相互作用占主导地位，尤其是在R268-F276残基附近。RRM2增加凝聚体堆积，而NTD则减少堆积。在RNA结合后，TDP-43的若干分子间相互作用被TDP-43-polyA相互作用所取代，从而改变凝聚体的黏弹性性质。具体而言，RRMs增强黏度，而NTD则降低黏度。polyA的存在增加弹性，使黏度和弹性在量级上相当。这些发现表明，TDP-43的多结构域结构及其RNA相互作用协调凝聚体的组织，调节其黏弹性性质。
